name: Houston
gaps: Source query returned 3269 rows; 2734 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are Parcels (Houston Public ISV, CAMA join) (https://web6.kcsgis.com/kcsgis/rest/services/Houston/Houston_Public_ISV/MapServer/29). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Property-appraiser links are stored from the card pattern and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. ALDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
